name: tcia_nsclc_radiomics_dicom
title: TCIA NSCLC-Radiomics: 422 lung-cancer CTs with RTSTRUCT and SEG contours (DICOM)
description: The original DICOM release of the Lung1 cohort (see hf_nsclc_radiomics for the NIfTI conversion): planning CT, the radiotherapy structure set (GTV, lungs, heart, oesophagus, spinal cord) and a DICOM SEG per patient. Series are listed through the public NBIA API (no account) and each one is downloaded as a zip of DICOM files on first access; the folder is then a DICOM volume (LPS mm from the headers).

license.note: CC BY 3.0 on the TCIA collection page (checked 2026-10-14).

citation: Aerts H.J.W.L., Wee L., Rios Velazquez E., et al. Data From NSCLC-Radiomics (version 4). The Cancer Imaging Archive, 2019. doi:10.7937/K9/TCIA.2015.PF0M9REI. Clark K., Vendt B., Smith K., et al. The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA): Maintaining and Operating a Public Information Repository. J Digit Imaging 26(6):1045-1057, 2013.

rtstruct.description: RTSTRUCT contours (GTV-1, lungs, heart, oesophagus, spinal cord)

seg.description: DICOM SEG of the same structures
